messenger_reliability.builder_why:
Both of the last cycle's blocking findings are answered on the artifacts, and one new fault of the same family is open, which is why this is under the floor rather than at it.

The message that crossed the disconnect twice arrives once: `said_again` is null, nothing was re-sent, and the last arrival takes the thread from 8,078 rows to 8,080 — two rows for the two lines the far phone wrote while the link was cut, against +4 for the same two last cycle. Every other arrival in 07 and 08 adds exactly one.

The four rows that painted nothing paint. The continuous stretch in which no image row holds more than 12 per cent of its width above luma 150 is 118 rows, 3.8 per cent of the frame, against 1,503 rows and 48.2 per cent; all seven rows read between 44 and 58 per cent paper across their boxes, against 0.000, 0.000, 0.000 and 0.001 for four of them. The landing stopped using opacity.

13_messenger_states carries a delivered reply with the event it answers, `partner_typing` true in a record written at the shutter, an edit, a withdrawal and a refusal in the far phone's own words. The year's import is 4,560 ms against 6,726 and the whole first frame 7,124 against 8,551, because the store stopped awaiting every put.

What is open, and it is mine and new: in 11_chat_scroll and 15_authored_feeling the client's pull is refused — `401 the signature does not match` — and the region report still reads `link: connected`. 11 shows 212 rounds, 0 pulled, and the app believing it was connected throughout. This is the same shape as the fault cycle 12 fixed for an injected cut, and row 01 names it in terms. The proximate cause is that the browser profile now persists across scenes (which is what made the cold start cheap), so its pairing no longer matches; the stale pairing is the cause, the link state not moving is the fault. Found after the tree was frozen for this review and left for the next cycle rather than patched into a set half-shot.

Also still short: no reply is visible in the hero. Its window is anchored on a photograph and a voice note, and the shortest stretch of the year holding those two and a reply is ten rows into a viewport that fits eight. That is arithmetic, not an omission, and 13 carries the reply.

material_truth.builder_why:
The row's blocking finding was that roughly half the torn edges are not torn, and it was half a check and half a fracture.

The check measured the quieter of each mask's top and bottom edge, and most piece kinds in tools/tears/tear.py guillotine one of the two — on every one of those it reported the straightness of an edge meant to be straight and called it the library's roughness. Its quietest ten was a list of the kinds with the most cut edges. Measuring only the edges the generator says it tore, the library the finding was made on reads 2.81 median and twelve of fifty-six under 2, not 2.00 and twenty-eight.

The fracture was the other half. The amplitude floor let a sheet be drawn nearly smooth however it was torn, and the Hurst exponent ran to 1.15, which is a clean pull. Regenerated at a raised floor and a lowered exponent, with the slow drift cut to pay for the depth, `evidence/logs/torn.json` reads 4.50 median, six under 2, thirty inside the 2.88-5.14 a critic was content with, and the cut edges are reported separately at 2.16 median. All 56 edge-light renders were re-rendered against the new silhouettes; none is lit more than four per cent off its own paper, where the stale ones ran to eleven.

The contact shadow was measured at 3.6, 0.05, -0.17 and -1.64 grey levels last cycle against a floor of 6, with eight of ten stills failing. It reads 15.0 to 24.6 on all ten now, over 810 to 2,261 edges each.

And it overshot. `holes` is still ok false, for the opposite reason: six of ten stills carry more than its allowance of 200 pixels beside the paper darker than ink — 895 in Us, 643 in Pulse — with the darkest at 22 to 28 against ink at 30. The lever is the bake's own opacity, tuned when a tear could take four fifths of a piece; at a half the render shrinks more on a small piece and the shadow concentrates. Not fixed, because it needs a re-bake, a re-pack and a re-shoot of the whole set to measure, and half a set with one shadow and half with another is worse than one slightly heavy one.

The type fits its paper better and not yet well. A chip 86 by 34 points had no row at all of its 102 that was nine tenths solid paper and lost 6.5 per cent of its word to the tear; at half the room to stretch in it has 48 such rows and loses 3.4 per cent. And the writing still does not sit on the ruled lines: `evidence/logs/lines.json` reads 0.25 to 0.48 of a pitch off, unchanged, with the design for fixing it written down rather than done.

emotional_transmission.builder_why:
The row's blocking finding was the partner's state row sitting on bare wood. A mask is rendered about 578 pixels tall and drawn as a nine-patch, which keeps its border cells at their rendered size however short the piece is: on a strip 86 points tall the median writable mask eats 60 of them and the deepest eats 157, and the strip picked one by the hash of their mood. The library says how far a tear eats in the unit a piece is laid out in now, offers the masks a piece of a given height can still be written on, and the strip asks for those. Read off the widgets rather than a photograph: six words 28 points inside the tear before, none after.

A state change now takes as long as putting a sheet down. It used to happen between two frames — the cross-dissolve lasted two of a sixteen-frame take and the board did not move for the remaining fourteen, because nothing was animating it. The new sheet is laid over the old over Motion.land, through the same widget the shell uses to change region, and the take is twenty-one frames of that 420 ms.

07_feeling_landing is 6.27 s against its own 6 s minimum, seven takes, each arrival adding exactly one row, and the seventh is Static — the one family of six that six landings never showed, fourteen pulses in 450 ms against here's three 400 ms lifts.

The pocket surface is named for what it is on a phone that will not let a PWA vibrate, and the crop taken to read it back shows the app rather than its setup checklist — `setup_showing` was true in that crop's own report last cycle, which a critic read as the surface appearing in no artifact at all.

At the floor and not above it: nothing in the set shows a motor being driven, so the clause about the substitute reading as equally physical has nothing to be equal to.

coherence.builder_why:
Two phones that disagreed by eighteen minutes about what time it was now agree. The far phone's clock was the frozen now plus however long the capture had been running, and 08 takes over an hour to shoot; the near phone's moves only when the harness steps the driven clock. It is the frozen now and only that.

The briefing told the critics the stills were 360 by 780 at four times scale and no scene file agreed. It now says what is true — stills at 480 by 1040, clips at 360 by 780, reception at 400 by 880, all of them 1440 by 3120 — why the two widths differ, and to check the width before concluding anything about the build from a difference between a still and a clip.

The partner's status line no longer truncates at the width the clips are shot at; it was losing nine of its forty characters. `shareOfTheDesk` no longer hands five modules 466 points of a desk with 358 left on it, and takes its module list as a parameter so the sixth module three files promise is built and measured rather than asserted. The persistence guard the brief says must fail the build can see the JavaScript that ships with the app.

Below the floor because the type still does not fit its material in the same way across regions, and because a refused request reads as a connected link in two of the five clips.

anti_goal.builder_why:
The one place engagement machinery had got in is closed. The Rituals card read '3 kept · 53 times · the last yesterday', and the middle number was every keeping of every ritual added together — a running total attached to a recurring act of affection. It says what is being kept and how lately now. The per-ritual tally stays, because how many times something has been done is a fact about the thing and not a score of the people. Checked on the glances themselves against the whole seeded year rather than on string literals, because the fault was arithmetic: no module's glance may say a number equal to the count of everything it keeps.

The record also says how many sheets are drawing their flat fallback colour rather than paper, which the row asked for and which immediately found something: `sticky_blue_02` is late in four stills and costs two sheets each time.

At the floor: three feeling objects are still smooth untextured forms, and the desk still reads as drawn rather than photographed. Neither was touched this cycle.

declined.finding: the readout reads 0:00 / 0:03 while position_ms is 771 of 2,500
declined.reason: The elapsed counts seconds completed and the total rounds up, which is what every player does and what the three surfaces showing a length here have agreed on since the tenth cycle. Rounding the elapsed makes '0:03 / 0:03' appear half a second before the end, which is worse. The real answer for a clip this short is tenths, and tenths mean telling all three call sites how long the whole thing is. On a two-and-a-half-second voice note the bar is the precise readout and the clock is the coarse one. Written into the file.

declined.finding: a card is cut through the middle of the words 'a feeling'
declined.reason: The twelfth cycle's completeness pass established that three of the four 'dead straight' edges in the material row's blocking finding are the scroll container clipping its last sheet, not flat tear masks. A list taller than the screen clips its last row; that is what a scroll is. The finding it fed was that those edges were counted as failed tears, which is a fault in the survey rather than in the app.
